title: Holding account reading
description: A holding account's balance, with the value each order holds there, for the check that they agree (REQ-AUD-15). It goes to the check, never to the log, which holds no balance (REQ-AUD-6). That each order is named once is checked by the Rust types.

provider.description: The provider whose module holds it.

node.description: The inner node it is at.

balance.description: Its balance, in the asset's unit.

word.description: Whose word the balance is: rutent's own reading at a public node, or the publisher's at a private one (REQ-AUD-15).

held_for.description: What each order holds there, each order once: empty where no order holds anything, never absent.

at.description: When it was read, by Core's clock.

held.description: The value one order holds in the account.

amount.description: The amount it holds there, in the asset's unit.
